description: This is a PHP source file defining the OrderStatus model class within the Opencart Catalog Localization namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve order status details from the database. It includes methods for fetching a specific order status by ID and for retrieving all order statuses, utilizing caching to improve performance.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: A model class handling order status retrieval and caching within the Opencart localization namespace.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Fetches a specific order status by its ID from the database, filtered by the current language ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all order statuses from the database, utilizing caching to optimize repeated access.
